arxiv-2112-12725.title: Permanence of the torsion-freeness property for divisible discrete quantum subgroups
arxiv-2112-12725.creator: Rubén Martos
arxiv-2112-12725.description: Abstract . We prove that torsion-freeness in the sense of Meyer-Nest is preserved under divisible discrete quantum subgroups. As a consequence, we obtain some stability results of the torsion-freeness property for relevant constructions of quantum groups (quantum (semi-)direct products, compact bicrossed products and quantum free products).

arxiv-2303-13403.title: Boosting quantum Monte Carlo and alleviating sign problem by Gutzwiller projection
arxiv-2303-13403.creator: Wei-Xuan Chang, Zi-Xiang Li
arxiv-2303-13403.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by Wei-Xuan Chang, Zi-Xiang Li. Here we develop a new scheme of projective quantum Monte-Carlo (QMC) simulation combining unbiased zero-temperature (projective) determinant QMC and variational Monte-Carlo based on Gutzwiller projection wave function, dubbed as “Gutzwiller projection QMC”. The numerical results demonstrate that employment of Gutzwiller projection trial wave function with minimum energy strongly speed up the convergence of computational results, thus tremendously reducing computational time in the simulation.

arxiv-2310-18091.title: Adversarial Anomaly Detection using Gaussian Priors and Nonlinear Anomaly Scores
arxiv-2310-18091.creator: Fiete Lüer, Tobias Weber, Maxim Dolgich, Christian Böhm
arxiv-2310-18091.description: Abstract Anomaly detection in imbalanced datasets is a frequent and crucial problem, especially in the medical domain where retrieving and labeling irregularities is often expensive. By combining the generative stability of a β \beta -variational autoencoder (VAE) with the discriminative strengths of generative adversarial networks (GANs), we propose a novel model, β \beta -VAEGAN.

arxiv-2402-04795.title: Stability under dwell time constraints: Discretization revisited
arxiv-2402-04795.creator: Thomas Mejstrik, Vladimir Yu. Protasov
arxiv-2402-04795.description: Abstract We decide the stability and compute the Lyapunov exponent of continuous-time linear switching systems with a guaranteed dwell time. The main result asserts that the discretization method with step size h h approximates the Lyapunov exponent with the precision C ​ h 2 C\,h^{2} , where C C is a constant.

arxiv-2402-15238.title: GPT-HateCheck : Can LLMs Write Better Functional Tests for Hate Speech Detection?
arxiv-2402-15238.description: Abstract Online hate detection suffers from biases incurred in data sampling, annotation, and model pre-training. Therefore, measuring the averaged performance over all examples in held-out test data is inadequate. Instead, we must identify specific model weaknesses and be informed when it is more likely to fail.

arxiv-2405-03278.title: Approximate Realizations for Outerplanaric Degree Sequences Thanks: This work was supported by US-Israel BSF grant no. 2022205.
arxiv-2405-03278.creator: Amotz Bar-Noy, Toni Böhnlein, David Peleg, Yingli Ran, Dror Rawitz
arxiv-2405-03278.description: Abstract We study the question of whether a sequence d = ( d 1 , d 2 , … , d n ) d=(d_{1},d_{2},\ldots,d_{n}) of positive integers is the degree sequence of some outerplanar (a.k.a. 1-page book embeddable) graph G G . If so, G G is an outerplanar realization of d d and d d is an outerplanaric sequence.

arxiv-2405-08312.title: Rotation and Abundances of the Benchmark Brown Dwarf HD 33632 Ab from Keck/KPIC High-resolution Spectroscopy Facilities: Keck:II (NIRSPEC), Keck:II (NIRC2)
arxiv-2405-08312.creator: Chih-Chun Hsu, Jason J. Wang (王劲飞), Jerry W. Xuan, Jean-Baptiste Ruffio, Evan Morris, Daniel Echeverri, Yinzi Xin, Joshua Liberman, Luke Finnerty, Katelyn Horstman, Ben Sappey, Gregory W. Doppmann, Dimitri Mawet, Nemanja Jovanovic, Michael P. Fitzgerald, Jacques-Robert Delorme, J. Kent Wallace, Ashl
arxiv-2405-08312.description: Abstract We present the projected rotational velocity and molecular abundances for HD 33632 Ab obtained via Keck Planet Imager and Characterizer high-resolution spectroscopy. HD 33632 Ab is a nearby benchmark brown dwarf companion at a separation of ∼ \sim 20 au that straddles the L/T transition.

arxiv-2409-05126.title: Quasicrystalline 30 ∘ twisted bilayer graphene: fractal patterns and electronic localization properties
arxiv-2409-05126.creator: Kevin J. U. Vidarte, Caio Lewenkopf
arxiv-2409-05126.description: Abstract The recently synthesized 30 ∘ twisted bilayer graphene (30 ∘ -TBG) systems are unique quasicrystal systems possessing dodecagonal symmetry with graphene’s relativistic properties. We employ a real-space numerical atomistic framework that respects both the dodecagonal rotational symmetry and the massless Dirac nature of the electrons to describe the local density of states of the system.

arxiv-2412-04644.title: A bimetric cosmological model based on Andreï Sakharov’s twin universe approach
arxiv-2412-04644.creator: Jean-Pierre Petit, Florent Margnat, Hicham Zejli
arxiv-2412-04644.description: Abstract The standard cosmological model, based on Cold Dark Matter and Dark Energy ( Λ \varLambda CDM), faces several challenges. Among these is the need to adjust the scenario to account for the presence of vast voids in the large-scale structure of the universe, as well as the early formation of the first stars and galaxies.

arxiv-2508-05809.title: On the strong metric dimension of the complement of the zero-divisor graph of a lattice
arxiv-2508-05809.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by . In this paper, we compute the strong metric dimension of the complement of the zero-divisor graph of the blow-up of a Boolean lattice. Using these results, we calculate the strong metric dimension of the total graph, the maximal graph, the intersection graph of ideals, the complement of the zero-divisor graph of a reduced ring, and the component graph of a vector space.

arxiv-2508-08815.title: GRainsaCK : a Comprehensive Software Library for Benchmarking Explanations of Link Prediction Tasks on Knowledge Graphs
arxiv-2508-08815.creator: Roberto Barile, Claudia d’Amato, Nicola Fanizzi
arxiv-2508-08815.description: Abstract Since Knowledge Graphs are often incomplete, link prediction methods are adopted for predicting missing facts. Scalable embedding based solutions are mostly adopted for this purpose, however, they lack comprehensibility, which may be crucial in several domains. Explanation methods tackle this issue by identifying supporting knowledge explaining the predicted facts.

arxiv-2601-18795.title: Reuse your FLOPs: Scaling RL on Hard Problems by Conditioning on Very Off-Policy Prefixes
arxiv-2601-18795.creator: Amrith Setlur, Zijian Wang, Andrew Cohen, Paria Rashidinejad, Sang Michael Xie
arxiv-2601-18795.description: Abstract Typical reinforcement learning (RL) methods for LLM reasoning waste compute on hard problems, where correct on-policy traces are rare, policy gradients vanish, and learning stalls. To bootstrap more efficient RL, we consider reusing old sampling FLOPs (from prior inference or RL training) in the form of off-policy traces.

pmc-10621170.title: Tumor-associated macrophage-derived exosomes LINC01592 induce the immune escape of esophageal cancer by decreasing MHC-I surface expression
pmc-10621170.creator: Xinwei Qiao, Zaixing Cheng, Kaming Xue, Cui Xiong, Zhikun Zheng, Xin Jin, Jinsong Li
pmc-10621170.description: BackgroundTAMs (tumor-associated macrophages) infiltration promotes the progression of esophageal cancer (EC). However, the underlying mechanisms remain unclear.MethodsAbnormal expression of LINC01592 from EC microarrays of the TCGA database was analyzed. LINC01592 expression level was validated in both EC cell lines and tissues. Stable LINC01592 knockdown and overexpression of EC cell lines were established.

pmc-11357199.title: Comparing Nutrient Profiles of Meat and Fish with Plant-Based Alternatives: Analysis of Nutrients, Ingredients, and Fortification Patterns
pmc-11357199.creator: Adam Drewnowski, Maaike J Bruins, Julia J F Besselink, Andrew G Hall
pmc-11357199.description: Nutrient quality of plant-based meat and fish alternative (MFA) products has been reported as variable. The present objective was to compare the nutrient density of raw meat and fish with MFA products and to examine MFA ingredients and fortification patterns.

pmc-11404868.title: Effects of acupuncture on shoulder impingement syndrome: A systematic review and meta-analysis
pmc-11404868.creator: Sang-Joon An, Woo-Chul Shin, Sungjun Joo, Jae-Heung Cho, Won-Seok Chung, Mi-Yeon Song, Hyungsuk Kim
pmc-11404868.description: Background:Shoulder impingement syndrome (SIS) is a common condition that causes chronic shoulder pain. The effectiveness of acupuncture in treating chronic shoulder pain has been documented in previous studies; however, existing systematic reviews and meta-analyses have often excluded Chinese databases and combined different types of acupuncture interventions, such as electroacupuncture, warm acupuncture, pharmacopuncture, and acupotomy.

pmc-12525285.title: Sex Differences in Predictors of Obstructive Sleep Apnea Risk Among Young Adults: A Cross-Sectional Study in Colombian University Students
pmc-12525285.creator: Juan Alberto Aristizábal-Hoyos, Olga Patricia López-Soto, Héctor Fuentes-Barría, Raúl Aguilera-Eguía, Lissé Angarita-Davila, Diana Rojas-Gómez
pmc-12525285.description: Objectives: This study aimed to identify anatomical and clinical predictors of moderate to high Obstructive Sleep Apnea (OSA) risk in a sample of university students, with an emphasis on sex-based differences. Methods: A cross-sectional study was conducted among 340 university students (148 males, 192 females) in Manizales, Colombia.

pmc-12571666.title: Innate immune-inflammatory signaling milieu in myeloid leukemia and aging-associated clonal hematopoiesis pathologies
pmc-12571666.creator: Satyaki Bhowmik, Anwesha Bose, Amitava Sengupta
pmc-12571666.description: Age-related accumulation of somatic mutations in hematopoietic stem and progenitor cells (HSPCs), causing clonal hematopoiesis (CH), often precedes the development of hematologic malignancies. Chronic inflammation and aberrant cytokine expression that are common in aging, contribute to clonal expansion and genomic instability.

pmc-12822892.title: Impact of perceived fatigue on sleep quality among critical care nurses in a selected hospital
pmc-12822892.creator: Ushapriya Mathiazhakan, Nisha Daniel, Shylu Vijayan, Sivaprakash Ravi
pmc-12822892.description: BACKGROUND:Fatigue and tiredness significantly affect sleep duration and timing, especially in critical care nurses working consecutive shifts without adequate rest. Symptoms such as lethargy, tiredness, and a constant need for sleep are commonly linked to fatigue and insufficient sleep, which can compromise nurse performance and patient care.

pmc-13037064.title: Incidentally detected abnormal findings on contrast-enhanced computed tomography scan during thrombosis screening after hip surgery: a retrospective study
pmc-13037064.creator: Akihito Oya, Taro Umezu, Ryo Ogawa, Atsuhiro Fujie, Takuto Hatakeyama, Arihiko Kanaji, Yasuo Niki, Morio Matsumoto, Masaya Nakamura
pmc-13037064.description: BackgroundVenous thromboembolism (VTE) is a potentially serious postoperative complication of hip surgery, including asymptomatic cases detectable by screening. During the study period, postoperative VTE screening was routinely performed using computed tomography pulmonary angiography (CTPA). CTPA is performed primarily to identify VTE, but other clinically significant abnormalities may be incidentally detected.

pmc-13113450.title: Albumin Protects Against Cyclophosphamide-Induced Hemorrhagic Cystitis by Scavenging Acrolein and Reactive Oxygen Species
pmc-13113450.creator: Zhuheng Shi, Zhimin Mao, Yingyu Zhang, Xiaoyu Su, Rui Jiang, Yang Sui, Xin Wang, Jie Cheng, Manabu Niimi, Jianglin Fan, Jian Yao
pmc-13113450.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). Cyclophosphamide (CYP) is an effective chemotherapeutic, but its use is limited by hemorrhagic cystitis caused by its toxic metabolite acrolein. Acrolein, when concentrated in the urine, triggers oxidative stress, leading to urothelial inflammation and cell death. Given that albumin is the most abundant plasma protein that contains free thiol groups capable of neutralizing electrophiles and oxidants, we, therefore, hypothesized that albumin could mitigate CYP-induced bladder injury. Here, we tested this hypothesis.

pmc-13114262.title: Decoding the Flavor Code of Fresh and Dried Tengjiao (Zanthoxylum armatum DC.) for Preparing Fried Tengjiao Oil Through Molecular Sensory Science
pmc-13114262.creator: Tianyu Dong, Panpan Wu, Jie Sun, Haitao Chen, Shuqi Wang
pmc-13114262.description: Fried Tengjiao oil is commonly used for seasoning spicy dishes, and both fresh and dried Tengjiao are used in its preparation. However, the flavor differences between fried Tengjiao oils prepared from these two types of raw materials have not yet been studied.

pmc-13576231.title: Development of and satisfaction with a short-term outpatient preventive medical service for working informal caregivers: a study protocol of a non-randomized prospective pilot study
pmc-13576231.creator: Sophia Boesl, Anna Pendergrass, Elmar Graessel, Natascha Lauer, Annabèlle Mesloh, Elke Hüttenrauch, Antonia Keck, Johanna Schmidt
pmc-13576231.description: BackgroundAbout 80% of care receivers (CRs) in Germany are cared for at home by family members or friends. These informal caregivers (CGs) often report a high burden from caregiving, which negatively affects their mental and physical health and often results in reduced work hours. CGs with statutory health insurance can apply for preventive medical services.

pmc-13641041.title: High‑resolution recombination landscape in Iranian native chicken ecotypes: Elevated hotspot density and candidate genes for heat and drought adaptation
pmc-13641041.creator: Leila Mohammadipour Saadatabadi, Hamed Kharrati-Koopaee, Zeinab Amiri Ghanatsaman, Ming-Shan Wang, Ali Esmailizadeh
pmc-13641041.description: Highlights•First high-resolution recombination map in Iranian indigenous chickens and higher rates than Leghorn.•Significantly higher recombination hotspot density in native ecotypes and Arian versus Leghorn.•Strong enrichment of recombination rates in telomeric regions (>100 cM/Mb) across all populations.•Protein-coding genes UNC13C, TRPM8, TLR3 and HSPB7 within hotspots linked to heat and drought adaptation.

pmc-13674438.title: Diversity and distribution of bacterial phytases
pmc-13674438.creator: Michael Weber, Lena‐Sophie Paul, Thilo M. Fuchs
pmc-13674438.description: Phytases: The stepwise dephosphorylation of phytate is catalyzed by phytases, a group of enzymes found mainly among bacteria and plants. Bacterial potential: We identified an unexpectedly widespread and previously underappreciated bacterial potential for phytate dephosphorylation, suggesting that microbial phytases play crucial roles in the environmental and host‐associated phosphorus flux.

uslaw-usc-t7-s1585.title: 7 U.S.C. § 1585 — Certain seeds not adapted for general agricultural use
uslaw-usc-t7-s1585.creator: United States Congress
uslaw-usc-t7-s1585.description: United States Code, Title 7 (Agriculture); Chapter 37 (Seeds); Subchapter III (Foreign Commerce). Current through Public Law 119-134, as published by the Office of the Law Revision Counsel. Whenever the Secretary of Agriculture, after a public hearing, determines that seed of alfalfa or red clover from any foreign country is not adapted for general agricultural use in the United States, the Secretary shall publish the determination and the reasons for the determination.
